title: Rows
description: Stacks widgets top to bottom. Each row's height is its weight: a number is a share (fr) of the space left, or a fixed size like 132px.

count.label: How many
count.help: Number of slots; put a widget (or null for an empty slot) in each child

weights.label: Weights
weights.help: One per slot, e.g. [1, 1.18, "132px"]; missing ones are 1

gap.label: Gap
gap.help: Space between slots, in design pixels
